notes: **Item MM1 of the M&M voice review** (item 1 in the chat): cut the text Potapenko et al. (2026a) already published down to his own "as described in detail by … Briefly, …" form, which his Mol Biol Evol paper uses for this same collection. The fixes for clarity and voice ("we", aim first) are included in the same paragraphs.

**Checked in the cited paper (Mol Ecol):** 300 plants from 30 sites across Israel · a design that breaks the link between environmental and geographic distance · six areas: three from the ecotype borders plus three intermediate zones · five sites per area chosen by environment and soil · ten plants at least 10 m apart · three rounds of single-seed descent · net-house in the Hula Valley with these coordinates, over three seasons · 5-L pots with full irrigation · randomized block design. **Not in Mol Ecol:** 4/4/5 blocks and "complete" (every accession in every block); both come from our phenotype table, as before.
**Removed** because the citation covers them: the Barley1K assignment wording, "site coordinates were recorded", the whole pre-sowing protocol, and the soil-mix brand.

Length: ¶1 goes from 150 to 107 words and the common-garden ¶1 from 131 to 72, about 100 words less. This is below my estimate in the chat (~170), because I kept the six regions (Fig. 2a and the carrier-origin analysis use them) and the seasons and blocks.
questions: **Ecotype names.** Mol Ecol does not name the three ecotypes in its sampling section; it says only "the known ecotypes". Mol Biol Evol names them ("north, coast, and desert"), and they are also our region labels in Fig. 2a. I kept "northern, coastal and desert ecotypes" as our own description, with no second citation. OK?
